question: Will Lamine Yamal win the Young Player Award at the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
rules:
This market will resolve to the player who wins the Young Player Award for the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

In the event of a tie, this market will resolve according to the official winner as determined by FIFA rules. If multiple winners are announced then this market will resolve to the player whose listed last name comes first alphabetically.

If the 2026 FIFA World Cup is cancelled, postponed after August 2, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or there is otherwise no winner declared within that timeframe, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from FIFA; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

evidence.excerpt: The FIFA Young Player Award will be presented to the best young player (born on or after 1 January 2005) in the final competition, as selected by the FIFA Technical Study Group. Spain's coach backed Lamine Yamal ahead of Monday's World Cup last-16 showdown with Portugal, saying he loves these kinds of games. In Atlanta, Lamine Yamal scored his first World Cup goal, opening the scoring in Spain's 4-0 win over Saudi Arabia at the age of 18 years and 343 days. He played the opening 45 minutes and scored by sliding in at the far post to finish Mikel Oyarzabal's cross.

Spain winger Lamine Yamal was fit and ready to come off the bench in his side's opening World Cup game, but manager Luis de la Fuente said his entrance would depend on how the match with Cape Verde progressed. Yamal had not played since April because of groin issues and a hamstring injury, and had missed Spain's recent friendlies.

Pau Cubarsi's date of birth is 22 January 2007 and his position is centre-back. Despite having only turned 19 a few months earlier, he had accumulated over 135 appearances for Barcelona. Cubarsi completed the full 90 minutes in three of Spain's final four qualifiers for the 2026 World Cup.

UEFA's team of technical observers named Lamine Yamal EURO 2024 Young Player of the Tournament. He recorded one goal, four assists and 32 dribbles, with the latter two totals both tournament highs. Yamal appeared in all seven of Spain's games, starting six, and assisted Nico Williams's opening goal in the final.

Argentina midfielder Enzo Fernandez was crowned Young Player of the FIFA World Cup Qatar 2022. Fernandez also became a world champion as Argentina beat France 4-2 on penalties after a 3-3 draw. The 21-year-old scored against Mexico in Argentina's 2-0 group-stage victory.
